enableEnvironments.title: Environments
enableEnvironments.description: Show environment management in company settings and allow project and agent environment assignment controls.

enableAiConnectionRouters.title: AI connection routers
enableAiConnectionRouters.description: Allow experimental plugin connections to choose task-pinned accounts and harnesses.

enableNativeRunner.title: Paperclip Runner
enableNativeRunner.description: Allow explicitly configured local Codex, OpenCode, and qualified ACPX agents to use the experimental Rust Paperclip Runner, including authenticated sandbox ingress when required. Onboarding remains on legacy adapters.

enableManagedSandboxOnly.title: Managed Environment Only
enableManagedSandboxOnly.description: Hide the local environment and run all agents in the platform-managed environment.

enableIsolatedWorkspaces.title: Isolated Workspaces
enableIsolatedWorkspaces.description: Show execution workspace controls in project configuration and allow isolated workspace behavior for task runs.

enableIsolatedWorkspacesByDefault.title: Isolated Workspaces By Default
enableIsolatedWorkspacesByDefault.description: Treat a project that has no execution workspace policy of its own as if it selected isolated workspaces, so its tasks get a per-task worktree instead of sharing the project checkout. Requires Isolated Workspaces. A project that carries its own policy keeps it.

enableStreamlinedLeftNavigation.title: Streamlined Left Navigation
enableStreamlinedLeftNavigation.description: Use the streamlined main sidebar navigation layout.

enableStreamlinedUi.title: Streamlined UI
enableStreamlinedUi.description: Use the streamlined application shell, shared task collections, focused task detail layout, contextual navigation, and simplified main sidebar.

enableApps.title: Apps (compatibility)
enableApps.description: Deprecated compatibility key. Apps is always enabled; stored and managed values are ignored.

enablePublicMcp.title: Assistant connections (MCP)
enablePublicMcp.description: Let external assistants connect as a person to review work, delegate tasks, add feedback, and follow results.

enableGitHubReviewBots.title: GitHub review bots
enableGitHubReviewBots.description: Show GitHub review bot setup and management independently of chat connectors. Existing bots keep running when hidden; GitHub tool connections are unaffected.

enableOpenAiDot.title: OpenAI Dot
enableOpenAiDot.description: Add OpenAI Dot as a standalone agent choice with its own experimental opt-in. Requires Assistant connections (MCP) and an authenticated instance with a public HTTPS URL.

enableChatConnectors.title: Chat connectors
enableChatConnectors.description: Show experimental chat connector setup and Board surfaces. Existing connections keep running when hidden; AgentMail, GitHub review bots, and tool connectors are unaffected.

enableMemoryConnectors.title: Memory connectors
enableMemoryConnectors.description: Show experimental Mem0, Zep, Supermemory, Cognee, and Honcho setup. Existing connections keep running when hidden.

enableMcpAggregators.title: MCP aggregators (compatibility)
enableMcpAggregators.description: Deprecated compatibility key. MCP aggregators are always enabled; stored and managed values are ignored.

enablePipelines.title: Pipelines
enablePipelines.description: Enable pipeline definitions and pipeline-driven case production surfaces.

enableCases.title: Cases
enableCases.description: Durable work products that tasks create and iterate on. Adds the Cases tab and the agent case API.

enableAgentChat.title: Agent Chat
enableAgentChat.description: Persistent task-backed conversations that clarify goals and hand work off to tasks. Chat leads the Work group with an agent rail, and each chat's side panel shows the agent's tasks and artifacts as cards.

enableCombinedInboxTasks.title: Combined Inbox + Task List
enableCombinedInboxTasks.description: Inbox becomes a set of views inside Tasks: one Tasks row in the nav carries the unread badge, and a Views menu reaches every inbox and task view.

enableConferenceRoomChat.title: Conference Room Chat
enableConferenceRoomChat.description: Add the Conference Room team chat, the live activity feed, and the redesigned onboarding; restyles task threads as chat bubbles.

enableClassicTaskInterface.title: Classic Task Interface
enableClassicTaskInterface.description: Restore the pre-chat task detail page: the page-level header with inline description editor, the plain comment thread, and the fixed Properties sidebar. Chat-only features (streaming activity folding, inline plan/question cards, the three-mode composer) are unavailable in the classic view.

enableIssuePlanDecompositions.title: Task Plan Decomposition
enableIssuePlanDecompositions.description: Show accepted-plan decomposition history on task detail pages.

enableExperimentalFileViewer.title: Experimental File Viewer
enableExperimentalFileViewer.description: Show task detail controls for browsing and previewing workspace files relative to a task.

enableStatusCards.title: Status Cards
enableStatusCards.description: Enable the experimental shared status-card board, update engine, and gated API.

enableExternalObjects.title: External Objects
enableExternalObjects.description: Detect external URLs in issues and show resolved status for pull requests, tickets, and other referenced work objects.

enableSmokeLab.title: Smoke Lab
enableSmokeLab.description: Add the Smoke Lab tab and dashboard card for exercising integration paths against deterministic local fixtures. Private deployments only.

enableBuiltInAgents.title: Built-in Agents
enableBuiltInAgents.description: Show Paperclip-managed built-in agent surfaces, including roster badges, the Built-in agents tab, and setup controls.

enableBetaSkills.title: Beta skills
enableBetaSkills.description: Allow agents to pin beta releases of the Paperclip core skill.

enableSummaries.title: Summaries
enableSummaries.description: Show Summarizer-generated status slots on project and workspace pages, with on-demand refresh and revision history.

enableDecisions.title: Decisions
enableDecisions.description: Show the Decisions item in the main sidebar — the attention home that surfaces tasks awaiting input.

enableFastResponses.title: Experimental fast responses
enableFastResponses.description: Show Connections in company settings and allow short acknowledgements while agents begin work.

enableGoalsSidebarLink.title: Goals Sidebar Link
enableGoalsSidebarLink.description: Restore the Goals item in the main sidebar while the goals surface is being evaluated.

enableSimplifiedEnglishInteractions.title: Simplified English Interactions
enableSimplifiedEnglishInteractions.description: Instruct agents to write user interactions (confirmations, questions, suggested tasks) in ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English with brief decision context.

enableServerInfoDebugView.title: Server Info Debug View
enableServerInfoDebugView.description: Show a Server section in the account drawer with the current server restart time and running commit.

enablePaperclipDeveloperMode.title: Paperclip Developer Mode
enablePaperclipDeveloperMode.description: Show internal Paperclip maintainer tools and observability links, including Honeycomb trace queries on run pages.

autoRestartDevServerWhenIdle.title: Auto-Restart Dev Server When Idle
autoRestartDevServerWhenIdle.description: In local development, wait for queued and running agent runs to finish, then restart the server automatically when backend changes make the current boot stale.

enableWorkspaceBranchReconcileForward.title: Workspace Branch Reconcile Forward
enableWorkspaceBranchReconcileForward.description: Let execution workspaces reconcile a diverged recorded branch forward instead of failing branch containment.

enableWorkspaceDirtyQuarantineRepair.title: Workspace Dirty Quarantine Repair
enableWorkspaceDirtyQuarantineRepair.description: Let workspace runtime recovery quarantine and repair dirty execution workspaces before runs.

enableOwnerInstanceAdmin.title: Owner Instance Admin
enableOwnerInstanceAdmin.description: On cloud-managed instances, grant the stack owner instance-admin access to their own dedicated instance. Elevation is computed at the trusted-header auth boundary; no instance admin role rows are created. Inert on self-hosted instances.

enableSandboxDuplexBridge.title: Sandbox Duplex Bridge
enableSandboxDuplexBridge.description: Let a run open the sandbox duplex command-stream bridge when the provider grants the capability. The host reads this per run before it selects the transport. Off keeps the file bridge for every run.

enableRunnerPreviewIngress.title: Runner Preview Ingress (Deprecated)
enableRunnerPreviewIngress.description: Compatibility-only key retained for older managed configs. Runner ingress follows the Paperclip Runner setting.

enableWorktreeRunExecution.title: Worktree Run Execution
enableWorktreeRunExecution.description: Let the scheduler execute runs inside an isolated git-worktree preview instance for tasks created after activation.

enableFirstTaskPlanProposal.title: First task: propose with a plan document
enableFirstTaskPlanProposal.description: When the user's first request is a single task, the chief of staff writes a short plan document and a checkbox card instead of a one-card confirmation. Applies to organizations created after the toggle is flipped.

enablePixelsOffice.title: Pixels Office
enablePixelsOffice.description: Show a live pixel-art office floor plan where each agent is a character and each character shows how many tasks that agent is holding.
